subject: Maths
title: Dividing fractions
subtitle: Fractions · KS3 Maths
learning_objective: I can divide fractions by flipping the second fraction and multiplying (KFC method).

key_vocab.definition: To divide by a fraction, Keep the first fraction, Flip the second (reciprocal), then Change to multiplication (KFC).

sections.title: Learning Objective
sections.content: I can divide fractions by flipping the second fraction and multiplying (KFC method).

sections.title: Key Words
sections.content: divide by a fraction -- To divide by a fraction, Keep the first fraction, Flip the second (reciprocal), then Change to multiplication (KFC).

sections.title: Method
sections.content:
Keep the first fraction. Flip the second. Change ÷ to ×.
&frac{a}{b} ÷ &frac{c}{d} = &frac{a}{b} × &frac{d}{c}
KFC: Keep, Flip, Change

Key examples:
  ✓ &frac{2}{3} ÷ &frac{1}{4} = &frac{2}{3} × &frac{4}{1} = &frac{8}{3}  (flip and multiply)
  ✓ &frac{3}{5} ÷ 2 = &frac{3}{5} × &frac{1}{2} = &frac{3}{10}  (2 = &frac{2}{1})
  ✓ Reciprocal of &frac{3}{4} is &frac{4}{3}  (flip)
  ✗ &frac{2}{3} ÷ &frac{1}{4} = &frac{2}{12}  (did not flip)
  ✗ Flip the first fraction  (flip the SECOND)

sections.title: Worked Example
Dividing by whole numbers
sections.content:
Write the whole number as a fraction first.

(a) &frac{3}{4} ÷ 3
(b) &frac{2}{5} ÷ 4
(c) &frac{5}{6} ÷ 5
(d) &frac{7}{8} ÷ 2
